svg.text: 1963 VOLKSWAGEN TYPE 2 (T1) KOMBI, CONVERTED TO A SERVICE VEHICLE
THIS ELEVATION HAS NEVER BEEN PHOTOGRAPHED.
WHAT IS DRAWN IS EVERYTHING THAT TRANSFERS FROM THE OTHER FLANK BY GEOMETRY. WHAT IS NOT DRAWN IS EVERYTHING ELSE.
INSIDE THE ROOF APERTURE: NO ROOF ABOVE 1.710 M AT \|Y\|<0.30
ROOF SLOPE -18.1 mm/m, MEASURED OFF THE MESH · RAKE APPLIED 17.75 mm/m
42.6 mm OF RISE FRONT TO REAR
SPEC.md GRADE E — NOT OBSERVED, DERIVED FROM WHAT A CORRECT 1963 T1 MUST BE.
THE FEATURES THIS FLANK IS SAID TO CARRY, AND WHICH NOTHING
WE HOLD CAN CONFIRM, PLACE OR CONTRADICT:
TWIN OUTWARD-HINGED CARGO DOORS + THREE GLAZED WINDOWS IN THE SAME BAY POSITIONS
THE MODEL ASSERTS THEM ANYWAY: 804.9 mm OF SHUT LINE OVER 2 PAIRS ON THIS FLANK,
AGAINST 0.0 mm ON THE PHOTOGRAPHED ONE. THAT IS A REGRESSION BASELINE, NOT A READING.
AND THE TWO FEATURES CONTRADICT EACH OTHER: THE WINDOWS ARE A MIRROR OF THE SHOW
FLANK — `side_cutters` LOOPS s IN (1,-1) — WHILE THE DOOR WAS PLACED INDEPENDENTLY.
SHOWN THE SIGHTLINES WITH EVERY BOX PRINTED, THE OWNER ANSWERED
KEY — THE LINE WEIGHT IS THE PROVENANCE
MEASURED OFF THE MESH, AND SYMMETRIC ABOUT THE CENTRE PLANE, SO IT TRANSFERS
DERIVED FROM A MEASURED FIGURE, NOT ITSELF MEASURED
ASSERTED BY THE MODEL, GRADED E, UNCONFIRMED BY ANY PHOTOGRAPH
ABSENT NO OUTLINE OF THIS FLANK EXISTS IN ANYTHING WE HOLD. DRAWING A PLAUSIBLE ONE IS THE DEFECT THIS PROJECT HAS PAID FOR MOST OFTEN.
sheet3_notissued.py — FIGURES READ AT DRAW TIME
GRADE E IS 'EXPERT INFERENCE — NOT OBSERVED'. '(NEVER PHOTOGRAPHED)' IS THIS ROW'S OWN ANNOTATION, NOT THE GRADE'S DEFINITION. AND SPEC.md STATES THE GRADE TABLE'S EVIDENCE
BASE AS A 246 × 197 px PHOTOGRAPH, WHICH THE RECORD HAS SINCE RETIRED. THREE OVERALL LENGTHS ARE CARRIED HERE AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME MEASUREMENT: 4065 mm EXCLUDING THE OPENED LIDS,
4317 mm INCLUDING THEM, AND 4580 mm 'EX COUNTER' AGAINST A SPECIFIED 4055 — +525.0 mm, STILL OUT. EVERY DISAGREEMENT ON THIS SHEET IS PRINTED BECAUSE IT IS REAL.
